title: Spring rate testing of shock coils
description: Spring rate testing of shock coils capability for titanium components
processDescription: Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) inspection provides quantitative dimensional verification of titanium components against GD&T specifications per ASME Y14.5. Touch-trigger probes, scanning heads, and non-contact laser sensors accommodate geometries from simple prismatic to complex freeform surfaces, specifically for springs. Precision springs for Oil & Gas present unique challenges: consistent wire diameter (±0.01 mm) and coil spacing. Fatigue life > 10⁷ cycles for aerospace springs. Surface defects (seams, pits) cause early failure.
heatControl: Temperature-controlled metrology lab at 20 ± 1°C. Components stabilized on granite surface plate for a minimum of 4 hours before measurement.
flatnessControl: Granite surface plate Grade 00 (flatness < 1 µm/m) used as reference datum.
capabilitiesDescription: NDT and dimensional inspection service for Spring rate testing of shock coils, performed by certified technicians per applicable standards.
